title: Axion Network — Using the unstake function of the Axion Staking contract, we managed to mint approximately 80 billion AXN tokens

summary_ko: 2020년 11월 2일 Axion Network 프로젝트에서 발행 로직 악용으로 $500,000가 탈취됐다.
summary_en: Cointelegraph reported that on November 2, a project called Axion Network launched the token AXN and was hacked a few hours after it was hacked. 79 billion AXN were minted and sold to the market. The token price was almost zero. The hacker made a profit of 1,300 ETH, or about $500,000.
